name: No-priced-node / missing-contributor derived line surfaced
what_it_tests: A derived line whose contributor parent has no priced node must not silently produce $0; the formula attempts fallbacks and the missing contributor is surfaced rather than masked
proc_mechanism: Stamp Contributor Base + Derived Pricing Formula fallback (IF Base_Price__c>0 ... else Pre_Partner ... else InputUnitPrice ... else 0); MissingContributor handling
expected_behavior: Formula tries Pre_Partner/InputUnitPrice; if all 0, net=0 flagged as missing contributor (not silently accepted)
test_setup: Derived maintenance line with parent license not priced (no contributor base)
